analyses distance--time graphs

- Identify and express one part of a ratio as a fraction of the whole

- Simplify ratios

    school days in term one. Write the following ratios in simplest

+----------------------+----------------------+----------------------+

|total days|total|present|
||||

    absent ...... days.
